channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: U.S. and Iran Exchange Fire Amid a Declared Truce
item.description: Iran will respond to a US peace proposal through Pakistan. An Iranian official said that Tehran would convey its reply through Pakistan, a key mediator. Another Iranian official had earlier dismissed a reported proposal to end the war as a “list of American wishes.”.

item.title: US navy came under missile fire after US attack on Iranian oil tanker, Iran state media says
item.description: Iranian media claims US warships were damaged and forced to retreat after a US attack on an Iranian oil tanker. Iranian media claimed US warships were damaged and forced to retreat after the attack.

item.title: Alarm raised as two drones crash in Nato country after crossing from Russia
item.description: Two drones crashed in a Nato country after crossing from Russia. Ukraine-Russia war latest: Alarm raised as two drones crash in Nato country after crossing from Russia The Independent.

item.description: Tennessee Republicans passed a new congressional map ahead of midterms. Republicans pass new map ahead of midterms after US Supreme Court weakened Voting Rights Act restrictions. Tennessee approves new congressional map in latest redistricting flurry.

item.description: Crystal Palace reached the Conference League final with a win over Shakhtar. Crystal Palace into Conference League final with win over Shakhtar.

item.title: Iran says it attacked US Navy ships after they targeted Iranian tanker
item.description: Iran attacked US Navy ships after they targeted an Iranian tanker. The US military responded to the attack. US military says it intercepted and responded to 'unprovoked' Iranian attack, stressing that it doesn't seek escalation.

item.description: Shakira unveiled the official World Cup song called Dai Dai. Shakira unveils official World Cup song 'Dai Dai'.

item.title: Trump sets July 4 deadline for EU tariff hike decision
item.description: Trump set a July 4 deadline for deciding on EU tariff hikes after a call with Ursula von der Leyen. Trump claimed he had a 'great call' European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen about the looming tariffs.

item.title: Trump gives 4 July ultimatum to EU to approve trade deal with US
item.description: US President Trump has given the European Union until July 4 to enact a trade deal agreed last year and drop tariffs on American goods to zero. The deal was agreed upon in 2021, but the EU has yet to meet its commitments.

item.title: Trump gives EU until July 4 to ratify deal or face tariff hike
item.description: US President Trump has set a July 4 deadline for the European Union to ratify a trade deal, warning that tariffs on American goods will increase if the EU fails to meet its commitments. Trump has been waiting for the EU to enact the deal agreed last year.

item.title: Armed fighters kill at least 30 people in attacks in central Mali
item.description: Al-Qaeda-affiliated fighters attacked two villages in central Mali's Mopti region, killing at least 30 people. The assailants struck on Wednesday, with several sources confirming the attack. Several sources tell Reuters and AFP the al-Qaeda-affiliated assailants hit two villages in Mopti region on Wednesday.

item.title: Iran state TV reports explosions on island in Hormuz strait
item.description: Iran is reviewing a US proposal for a deal to end the war as Trump pressures Tehran for an agreement. Tehran denies allegations its forces were behind a blast on a Panama-flagged ship.

item.title: Russia Ramps Up Threats Toward Ukraine Over Victory Day Parade
item.description: Kremlin officials have threatened a large strike on Kyiv if Ukraine disrupts the May 9 Victory Day parade. President Volodymyr Zelensky has hinted at disrupting the event, prompting the Kremlin's warning.

item.title: Trump Says Giving EU Until July 4 To Fulfill Trade Deal Or Will Raise Tariffs
item.description: US President Trump has threatened to raise tariffs on EU cars and trucks to 25% if the EU does not comply with a trade deal struck in Scotland last July. The current tariff rate is 15%, and Trump has given the EU until this week to comply.

item.title: Trump hails talks with Brazil’s Lula despite earlier tensions
item.description: Trump met Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva to discuss trade and tariffs. “Just concluded my meeting with Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, the very dynamic President of Brazil.

item.title: US and Iran close to temporary truce, Pakistani officials claim
item.description: Pakistani officials claim the US and Iran are close to a temporary truce. The details of the agreement are not specified, but it is said to be a tentative arrangement.

item.title: Hantavirus outbreak on cruise ship not start of pandemic, UN health agency says
item.description: The World Health Organization says a hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship is not the start of a pandemic. Ther World Health Organization says it is not in the same situation as with Covid-19 because hantavirus spreads differently.
